missing: Dabocemagene autoficel (D-Fi/FCX-007) has no track: model = gene-corrected RDEB fibroblasts injected intradermally into RDEB skin xenografts on SCID mice (Woodley 2003 J Invest Dermatol, doi:10.1046/j.1523-1747.2003.12571.x, product_in_model false; Fibrocell's own FCX-007 SCID-xenograft data only in a 2015 ASHG poster). Patient side: phase 1/2 NCT02810951 registry results (complete wound closure 40%/80% treated vs 0% untreated wounds, primary was AEs) and phase 3 DEFI-RDEB NCT04213261 registry results (primary: complete closure of first wound pair at week 24, 1 vs 0; trial stopped early). Likely an efficacy entry untested/unsettled, or a paired comparison.

Earlier protein-replacement model for PTR-01 track: fibroblast-derived rC7 injected into RDEB skin xenografts / IV in engrafted mice (Woodley 2004 Nat Med; Remington 2009 Mol Ther, cited in Hou 2015 abstract) - could move the col7-null/rC7 track opening year before 2015.
Hologene 7 (NCT02984085, terminated, no results): no admissible model or patient source found; the note's claim holds.
rule_questions: Dating: Krystal's GEM-3 topline (Nov 2021) and Abeona's VIITAL topline (Nov 2022) press releases precede the tier-1 papers; rule 6 lists registry/epub/label/print but not tier-5 releases. Should a tier-5 release date an entry when a higher-tier record later sets its status?

Product identity: PTR-01 is CHO-derived rC7 licensed from Shire; whether it is the exact CHO-rhC7 of Hou 2015 (product_in_model true vs false) is unconfirmed - does uncertainty default product_in_model to null, as drafted?
The DEFI-RDEB phase 3 (1 vs 0 closures, stopped early for vector supply) - is an underpowered terminated trial 'unsettled' (untested) or a contra for a model predicting healing?

Retrodiction for engagement/efficacy counts 'any other drug' on the same target: do allogeneic or normal-fibroblast injections in RDEB patients (C7 at the DEJ, e.g. Wong 2008 JID) count as the same target and action, which would make the 2010-2015 pz-cel and rC7 models retrodictions?

PTR-01 track opening year: Hou 2015 distinguishes CHO-rhC7 from the fibroblast-derived rhC7 of Woodley 2013; is the earlier FB-rhC7 IV system the same model system as CHO-rhC7 in C7-null mice (opener 2013) or a separate one (2015)? This round's verdicts treat them as separate, reversing the earlier 2013 proposal.
